proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C
  have ap := EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_two_mul_dist_midpoint_sq_add_half_dist_sq A B C
  rw [← EuclideanGeometry.dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two B A C, dist_comm B A, dist_comm C A]
  constructor
  · intro e
    refine (mul_self_inj dist_nonneg (by positivity)).mp ?_
    nlinarith
  · intro e
    rw [e] at ap
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi / 2 ↔ dist A (midpoint ℝ B C) = dist B C / 2
